module

public import Aglib.AlgebraicGeometry.Cohomology.StructureSheaf.KunnethLinear.Basic
public import Aglib.AlgebraicGeometry.Cohomology.StructureSheaf.ExternalProduct.Graded
import Lean
import Lean.Util.Heartbeats

/-!
# Whole comparison of the original signed and linear Kunneth maps

The original graded external product and the degreewise Kunneth map agree on
whole homogeneous tensor maps. The generic total-degree comparison composes
those laws before any native cohomology value is evaluated.
-/

@[expose] public noncomputable section

open scoped TensorProduct DirectSum

universe u m n p v

private meta def h1ProbeParts (e : Lean.Expr) : Lean.Expr × Array Lean.Expr := Id.run do
  let mut cursor := e
  let mut args := #[]
  for _ in [:64] do
    match cursor with
    | .app f a => args := #[a] ++ args; cursor := f
    | .mdata _ b => cursor := b
    | _ => break
  return (cursor, args)

private meta def h1ProbeHead (e : Lean.Expr) : Lean.MetaM String := do
  let (h, a) := h1ProbeParts e
  let n ← match h with
    | .const n _ => pure s!"const:{n}"
    | .fvar id => pure s!"local:{(← id.getDecl).userName.eraseMacroScopes}"
    | .bvar i => pure s!"bound:{i}"
    | .mvar id => do
      let d ← id.getDecl
      pure s!"mvar:{id.name};name={d.userName};typeHead={d.type.getAppFn.constName?}"
    | .lam n _ b _ => pure s!"lambda:{n};body={b.getAppFn.constName?}"
    | .forallE n _ _ _ => pure s!"forall:{n}"
    | .proj n i _ => pure s!"projection:{n}.{i}"
    | .sort _ => pure "Sort"
    | .letE n _ _ _ _ => pure s!"let:{n}"
    | _ => pure "other"
  return s!"{n};args={a.size}"

private meta def h1ProbeSpine (label : String) (e : Lean.Expr) : Lean.MetaM Unit := do
  let (_, args) := h1ProbeParts e
  Lean.logInfo m!"HF_PROBE.{label}.HEAD {← h1ProbeHead e}"
  for i in [:min 24 args.size] do
    let a := args[i]!
    if (← Lean.Meta.isProofQuick a) == .true then
      Lean.logInfo m!"HF_PROBE.{label}.ARG{i} PROOF_VALUE_SKIPPED \
        type={← h1ProbeHead (← Lean.Meta.inferType a)}"
    else
      Lean.logInfo m!"HF_PROBE.{label}.ARG{i} {← h1ProbeHead a}"

private meta def h1ProbeDiff (state : IO.Ref (Nat × Nat × Nat)) :
    Nat → String → Lean.Expr → Lean.Expr → Lean.MetaM Unit
  | 0, _, _, _ => pure ()
  | fuel + 1, path, x, y => do
    let (visited, differences, proofChecks) ← state.get
    if visited ≥ 500 || differences ≥ 12 || x == y then return
    state.set (visited + 1, differences, proofChecks)
    if !x.hasLooseBVars && !y.hasLooseBVars then
      let qx ← Lean.Meta.isProofQuick x
      let qy ← Lean.Meta.isProofQuick y
      let mut px := qx == .true
      let mut py := qy == .true
      if qx == .undef || qy == .undef then
        if proofChecks ≥ 32 then
          Lean.logInfo m!"HF_PROBE.UNKNOWN_PROOF_STATUS_SKIPPED {path}"
          return
        state.modify fun (a,b,c) => (a,b,c+1)
        px ← Lean.Meta.isProof x
        py ← Lean.Meta.isProof y
      if px || py then
        let tx ← Lean.Meta.inferType x
        let ty ← Lean.Meta.inferType y
        Lean.logInfo m!"HF_PROBE.PROOF_VALUES_SKIPPED {path};bothProof={px && py};\
          sameType={tx == ty};types={← h1ProbeHead tx} / {← h1ProbeHead ty}"
        if px && py then h1ProbeDiff state fuel (path ++ ".proofType") tx ty
        return
    match x, y with
    | .app xf xa, .app yf ya =>
      h1ProbeDiff state fuel (path ++ ".fn") xf yf
      h1ProbeDiff state fuel (path ++ ".arg") xa ya
    | .mdata _ xb, _ => h1ProbeDiff state fuel path xb y
    | _, .mdata _ yb => h1ProbeDiff state fuel path x yb
    | .lam xn xt xb _, .lam _ yt yb _ =>
      h1ProbeDiff state fuel (path ++ ".lambdaType") xt yt
      if xt == yt then
        Lean.Meta.withLocalDeclD xn xt fun v =>
          h1ProbeDiff state fuel (path ++ ".lambdaBody") (xb.instantiate1 v) (yb.instantiate1 v)
    | .forallE xn xt xb _, .forallE _ yt yb _ =>
      h1ProbeDiff state fuel (path ++ ".binderType") xt yt
      if xt == yt then
        Lean.Meta.withLocalDeclD xn xt fun v =>
          h1ProbeDiff state fuel (path ++ ".binderBody") (xb.instantiate1 v) (yb.instantiate1 v)
    | .proj xn xi xb, .proj yn yi yb =>
      if xn == yn && xi == yi then h1ProbeDiff state fuel (path ++ ".projection") xb yb
      else
        state.modify fun (a,b,c) => (a,b+1,c)
        Lean.logInfo m!"HF_PROBE.DIFF {path}; {← h1ProbeHead x} / {← h1ProbeHead y}"
    | _, _ =>
      state.modify fun (a,b,c) => (a,b+1,c)
      Lean.logInfo m!"HF_PROBE.DIFF {path}; {← h1ProbeHead x} / {← h1ProbeHead y}"

private meta def h1RunDiff (label : String) (x y : Lean.Expr) : Lean.MetaM Unit := do
  let state ← IO.mkRef (0, 0, 0)
  h1ProbeDiff state 48 label x y
  let (n,d,p) ← state.get
  Lean.logInfo m!"HF_PROBE.DIFF_END {label};visited={n};differences={d};\
    proofChecks={p};limits=500/12/32/depth48"

private meta def h1ProbeMVars (label : String) (e : Lean.Expr) : Lean.MetaM Unit := do
  let mut stack : Array (Nat × Lean.Expr) := #[(0, e)]
  let mut seen : Array Lean.MVarId := #[]
  let mut visited := 0
  let mut proofValues := 0
  while !stack.isEmpty && visited < 1200 && seen.size < 16 do
    let (depth, value) := stack.back!
    stack := stack.pop
    visited := visited + 1
    if depth > 48 then continue
    if let .mvar id := value then
      unless seen.contains id do
        seen := seen.push id
        let d ← id.getDecl
        Lean.logInfo m!"HF_PROBE.MVAR {label};id={id.name};name={d.userName};\
          assigned={← id.isAssigned};type={← h1ProbeHead d.type}"
      continue
    if !value.hasLooseBVars && (← Lean.Meta.isProofQuick value) == .true then
      proofValues := proofValues + 1
      stack := stack.push (depth + 1, ← Lean.Meta.inferType value)
      continue
    match value with
    | .app f a =>
      stack := stack.push (depth + 1, a)
      stack := stack.push (depth + 1, f)
    | .lam _ t b _ | .forallE _ t b _ =>
      stack := stack.push (depth + 1, t)
      stack := stack.push (depth + 1, b)
    | .letE _ t v b _ =>
      stack := stack.push (depth + 1, t)
      stack := stack.push (depth + 1, v)
      stack := stack.push (depth + 1, b)
    | .mdata _ b | .proj _ _ b => stack := stack.push (depth + 1, b)
    | _ => pure ()
  Lean.logInfo m!"HF_PROBE.MVAR_END {label};nodes={visited};mvars={seen.size};\
    proofValuesSkipped={proofValues};pending={stack.size};limits=1200/16/depth48"

private meta def h1ProbeInnerComp (label : String) (e : Lean.Expr) : Lean.MetaM Unit := do
  let (_, args) := h1ProbeParts e
  for i in [:min 24 args.size] do
    if args[i]!.getAppFn.constName? == some ``LinearMap.comp then
      h1ProbeSpine (label ++ s!".argument{i}") args[i]!

private meta def h1ProbeEquations : Nat → Lean.Expr → Lean.Expr → Lean.MetaM Unit
  | 0, _, _ => Lean.logInfo "HF_PROBE.BINDER_LIMIT"
  | fuel + 1, expected, actual => do
    match expected, actual with
    | .forallE n et eb _, .forallE _ actualTy ab _ =>
      Lean.logInfo m!"HF_PROBE.BINDER {n};sameRawType={et == actualTy};\
        types={← h1ProbeHead et} / {← h1ProbeHead actualTy}"
      if et == actualTy then
        Lean.Meta.withLocalDeclD n et fun x =>
          h1ProbeEquations fuel (eb.instantiate1 x) (ab.instantiate1 x)
      else
        h1RunDiff "BINDER_TYPES" et actualTy
    | _, _ =>
      let (eh, ea) := h1ProbeParts expected
      let (ah, aa) := h1ProbeParts actual
      Lean.logInfo m!"HF_PROBE.EQUATION_HEADS {← h1ProbeHead expected} / \
        {← h1ProbeHead actual}"
      if eh.constName? == some ``Eq && ah.constName? == some ``Eq &&
          ea.size == 3 && aa.size == 3 then
        h1ProbeSpine "EXPECTED_CARRIER" ea[0]!
        h1ProbeSpine "ACTUAL_CARRIER" aa[0]!
        h1ProbeSpine "EXPECTED_LEFT" ea[1]!
        h1ProbeSpine "ACTUAL_LEFT" aa[1]!
        h1ProbeInnerComp "EXPECTED_INNER_COMP" ea[1]!
        h1ProbeInnerComp "ACTUAL_INNER_COMP" aa[1]!
        h1ProbeSpine "EXPECTED_RIGHT" ea[2]!
        h1ProbeSpine "ACTUAL_RIGHT" aa[2]!
        if (← Lean.getRemainingHeartbeats) < 20000000 then
          Lean.logInfo "HF_PROBE.LOW_BUDGET_STOP_BEFORE_DIFF"
          return
        h1RunDiff "CARRIER" ea[0]! aa[0]!
        h1RunDiff "LEFT" ea[1]! aa[1]!
        h1RunDiff "RIGHT" ea[2]! aa[2]!
      else
        Lean.logInfo "HF_PROBE.NOT_TWO_LITERAL_EQUATIONS"

elab "h1_probe_hF% " producer:term : term <= expectedType => do
  Lean.logInfo m!"HF_PROBE.ENTRY remaining={(← Lean.getRemainingHeartbeats) / 1000};\
    max={(← Lean.getMaxHeartbeats) / 1000}"
  let expected ← Lean.instantiateMVars expectedType
  Lean.logInfo m!"HF_PROBE.EXPECTED_FLAGS expr={expected.hasExprMVar};\
    level={expected.hasLevelMVar}"
  h1ProbeMVars "EXPECTED_BEFORE_PRODUCER" expected
  let value ← Lean.Elab.Term.elabTerm producer none
  let value ← Lean.instantiateMVars value
  let actual ← Lean.Meta.inferType value
  Lean.logInfo m!"HF_PROBE.PRODUCER_ELABORATED remaining=\
    {(← Lean.getRemainingHeartbeats) / 1000};actualHasMVar={actual.hasMVar}"
  Lean.logInfo m!"HF_PROBE.ACTUAL_FLAGS expr={actual.hasExprMVar};\
    level={actual.hasLevelMVar}"
  h1ProbeMVars "ACTUAL_PRODUCER_TYPE" actual
  let expectedAfter ← Lean.instantiateMVars expectedType
  h1ProbeMVars "EXPECTED_AFTER_STANDALONE_PRODUCER" expectedAfter
  h1ProbeEquations 4 expectedAfter actual
  Lean.logInfo m!"HF_PROBE.DONE remaining={(← Lean.getRemainingHeartbeats) / 1000}"
  throwError "HF_PROBE_INTENTIONAL_STOP"

namespace DirectSum

variable {R : Type u} [CommSemiring R]
  (M : ℕ → Type m) (N : ℕ → Type n)
  [∀ i, AddCommMonoid (M i)] [∀ i, Module R (M i)]
  [∀ j, AddCommMonoid (N j)] [∀ j, Module R (N j)]

private theorem tensorPiLinearMap_eq_of_values
    (P : ℕ → Type p) [∀ i, AddCommMonoid (P i)] [∀ i, Module R (P i)]
    (E : ((⨁ i, M i) ⊗[R] ⨁ j, N j) ≃ₗ[R]
      ⨁ t, ⨁ s : HomologicalComplex₂.TotalDegree t,
        M s.val.1 ⊗[R] N s.val.2)
    (hE : E = tensorFiberEquiv (R := R) M N
      (ComplexShape.π (ComplexShape.up ℕ) (ComplexShape.up ℕ) (ComplexShape.up ℕ)))
    (F : ((⨁ i, M i) ⊗[R] ⨁ j, N j) →ₗ[R] ⨁ i, P i)
    (G : ∀ t, (⨁ s : HomologicalComplex₂.TotalDegree t,
      M s.val.1 ⊗[R] N s.val.2) →ₗ[R] P t)
    (h : ∀ i j (x : M i) (y : N j),
      F (lof R ℕ M i x ⊗ₜ[R] lof R ℕ N j y) =
        lof R ℕ P (i + j)
          (G (i + j) (lof R (HomologicalComplex₂.TotalDegree (i + j))
            (fun s => M s.val.1 ⊗[R] N s.val.2)
            ⟨(i, j), rfl⟩ (x ⊗ₜ[R] y)))) :
    F = mapAfterEquiv E G := by
  subst E
  exact tensorTotalLinearMap_eq (R := R) M N P F G h

variable {M N}

/-- The original component equations fix their actual intermediate maps.
Their composition and evaluation take place over the variable modules. -/
private theorem tensorPiLinearMap_eq
    (E : ((⨁ i, M i) ⊗[R] ⨁ j, N j) ≃ₗ[R]
      ⨁ t, ⨁ s : HomologicalComplex₂.TotalDegree t,
        M s.val.1 ⊗[R] N s.val.2)
    (hE : E = tensorFiberEquiv (R := R) M N
      (ComplexShape.π (ComplexShape.up ℕ) (ComplexShape.up ℕ) (ComplexShape.up ℕ)))
    {P : ℕ → Type p} [∀ i, AddCommMonoid (P i)] [∀ i, Module R (P i)]
    (G : ∀ t, (⨁ s : HomologicalComplex₂.TotalDegree t,
      M s.val.1 ⊗[R] N s.val.2) →ₗ[R] P t)
    {S : Type v} [AddCommMonoid S] [Module R S]
    {Φ : S →ₗ[R] ⨁ i, P i}
    {s : ((⨁ i, M i) ⊗[R] ⨁ j, N j) →ₗ[R] S}
    {T : ∀ i j, M i ⊗[R] N j →ₗ[R] P (i + j)}
    (hF : ∀ i j,
      Φ ∘ₗ s ∘ₗ TensorProduct.map (lof R ℕ M i) (lof R ℕ N j) =
        lof R ℕ P (i + j) ∘ₗ T i j)
    (hG : ∀ i j,
      G (i + j) ∘ₗ
          lof R (HomologicalComplex₂.TotalDegree (i + j))
            (fun s => M s.val.1 ⊗[R] N s.val.2) ⟨(i, j), rfl⟩ = T i j) :
    Φ ∘ₗ s = mapAfterEquiv E G := by
  apply tensorPiLinearMap_eq_of_values M N P E hE (Φ ∘ₗ s) G
  intro i j x y
  have hValue := LinearMap.congr_fun (hF i j) (x ⊗ₜ[R] y)
  have hOriginal := LinearMap.congr_fun (hG i j) (x ⊗ₜ[R] y)
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, TensorProduct.map_tmul] at hValue hOriginal
  exact hValue.trans (congrArg (lof R ℕ P (i + j)) hOriginal.symm)

end DirectSum

open CategoryTheory MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory AlgebraicGeometry
open AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.OverField

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Cohomology

attribute [local instance] Over.cartesianMonoidalCategory

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (X Y : FScheme k)

/-- The original degree map after its original fiber inclusion is the original tensor map. -/
private theorem structureKunnethMap_component (p q : ℕ) :
    structureKunnethMap X Y (p + q) ∘ₗ
        DirectSum.lof k (HomologicalComplex₂.TotalDegree (p + q))
          (fun s => structureCohomology k X s.val.1 ⊗[k]
            structureCohomology k Y s.val.2) ⟨(p, q), rfl⟩ =
      structureExternalTensor X Y (p := p) (q := q) rfl := by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro z
  exact structureKunnethMap_lof X Y (p + q) ⟨(p, q), rfl⟩ z

/-- Whole equality from the original signed value and original degreewise kappa. -/
theorem structureExternalLinearMap_signed :
    (structureExternalAlgebraMap X Y).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
        (structureExternalTensorSourceEquiv X Y).toLinearMap =
      structureExternalLinearMap X Y := by
  run_tac Lean.logInfo m!"HF_PROBE.BEFORE_APPLICATION \
    remaining={(← Lean.getRemainingHeartbeats) / 1000}"
  have hWhole := DirectSum.tensorPiLinearMap_eq (R := k)
    (structureTensorTotalSourceEquiv X Y) rfl
    (structureKunnethMap X Y)
    (h1_probe_hF% (fun (p q : ℕ) =>
      structureExternalAlgebraMap_tensor X Y (p := p) (q := q) rfl))
    (structureKunnethMap_component X Y)
  exact hWhole

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Cohomology

  let mut visited := 0
  let mut proofValues := 0
  while !stack.isEmpty && visited < 1200 && seen.size < 16 do
    let (depth, value) := stack.back!
    stack := stack.pop
    visited := visited + 1
    if depth > 48 then continue
    if let .mvar id := value then
      unless seen.contains id do
        seen := seen.push id
        let d ← id.getDecl
        Lean.logInfo m!"HF_PROBE.MVAR {label};id={id.name};name={d.userName};\
          assigned={← id.isAssigned};type={← h1ProbeHead d.type}"
      continue
    if !value.hasLooseBVars && (← Lean.Meta.isProofQuick value) == .true then
      proofValues := proofValues + 1
      stack := stack.push (depth + 1, ← Lean.Meta.inferType value)
      continue
    match value with
    | .app f a =>
      stack := stack.push (depth + 1, a)
      stack := stack.push (depth + 1, f)
    | .lam _ t b _ | .forallE _ t b _ =>
      stack := stack.push (depth + 1, t)
      stack := stack.push (depth + 1, b)
    | .letE _ t v b _ =>
      stack := stack.push (depth + 1, t)
      stack := stack.push (depth + 1, v)
      stack := stack.push (depth + 1, b)
    | .mdata _ b | .proj _ _ b => stack := stack.push (depth + 1, b)
    | _ => pure ()
  Lean.logInfo m!"HF_PROBE.MVAR_END {label};nodes={visited};mvars={seen.size};\
    proofValuesSkipped={proofValues};pending={stack.size};limits=1200/16/depth48"

private meta def h1ProbeInnerComp (label : String) (e : Lean.Expr) : Lean.MetaM Unit := do
  let (_, args) := h1ProbeParts e
  for i in [:min 24 args.size] do
    if args[i]!.getAppFn.constName? == some ``LinearMap.comp then
      h1ProbeSpine (label ++ s!".argument{i}") args[i]!

private meta def h1ProbeEquations : Nat → Lean.Expr → Lean.Expr → Lean.MetaM Unit
  | 0, _, _ => Lean.logInfo "HF_PROBE.BINDER_LIMIT"
  | fuel + 1, expected, actual => do
    match expected, actual with
    | .forallE n et eb _, .forallE _ actualTy ab _ =>
      Lean.logInfo m!"HF_PROBE.BINDER {n};sameRawType={et == actualTy};\
        types={← h1ProbeHead et} / {← h1ProbeHead actualTy}"
      if et == actualTy then
        Lean.Meta.withLocalDeclD n et fun x =>
          h1ProbeEquations fuel (eb.instantiate1 x) (ab.instantiate1 x)
      else
        h1RunDiff "BINDER_TYPES" et actualTy
    | _, _ =>
      let (eh, ea) := h1ProbeParts expected
      let (ah, aa) := h1ProbeParts actual
      Lean.logInfo m!"HF_PROBE.EQUATION_HEADS {← h1ProbeHead expected} / \
        {← h1ProbeHead actual}"
      if eh.constName? == some ``Eq && ah.constName? == some ``Eq &&
          ea.size == 3 && aa.size == 3 then
        h1ProbeSpine "EXPECTED_CARRIER" ea[0]!
        h1ProbeSpine "ACTUAL_CARRIER" aa[0]!
        h1ProbeSpine "EXPECTED_LEFT" ea[1]!
        h1ProbeSpine "ACTUAL_LEFT" aa[1]!
        h1ProbeInnerComp "EXPECTED_INNER_COMP" ea[1]!
        h1ProbeInnerComp "ACTUAL_INNER_COMP" aa[1]!
        h1ProbeSpine "EXPECTED_RIGHT" ea[2]!
        h1ProbeSpine "ACTUAL_RIGHT" aa[2]!
        if (← Lean.getRemainingHeartbeats) < 20000000 then
          Lean.logInfo "HF_PROBE.LOW_BUDGET_STOP_BEFORE_DIFF"
          return
        h1RunDiff "CARRIER" ea[0]! aa[0]!
        h1RunDiff "LEFT" ea[1]! aa[1]!
        h1RunDiff "RIGHT" ea[2]! aa[2]!
      else
        Lean.logInfo "HF_PROBE.NOT_TWO_LITERAL_EQUATIONS"

elab "h1_probe_hF% " producer:term : term <= expectedType => do
  Lean.logInfo m!"HF_PROBE.ENTRY remaining={(← Lean.getRemainingHeartbeats) / 1000};\
    max={(← Lean.getMaxHeartbeats) / 1000}"
  let expected ← Lean.instantiateMVars expectedType
  Lean.logInfo m!"HF_PROBE.EXPECTED_FLAGS expr={expected.hasExprMVar};\
    level={expected.hasLevelMVar}"
  h1ProbeMVars "EXPECTED_BEFORE_PRODUCER" expected
  let value ← Lean.Elab.Term.elabTerm producer none
  let value ← Lean.instantiateMVars value
  let actual ← Lean.Meta.inferType value
  Lean.logInfo m!"HF_PROBE.PRODUCER_ELABORATED remaining=\
    {(← Lean.getRemainingHeartbeats) / 1000};actualHasMVar={actual.hasMVar}"
  Lean.logInfo m!"HF_PROBE.ACTUAL_FLAGS expr={actual.hasExprMVar};\
    level={actual.hasLevelMVar}"
  h1ProbeMVars "ACTUAL_PRODUCER_TYPE" actual
  let expectedAfter ← Lean.instantiateMVars expectedType
  h1ProbeMVars "EXPECTED_AFTER_STANDALONE_PRODUCER" expectedAfter
  h1ProbeEquations 4 expectedAfter actual
  Lean.logInfo m!"HF_PROBE.DONE remaining={(← Lean.getRemainingHeartbeats) / 1000}"
  throwError "HF_PROBE_INTENTIONAL_STOP"
